design_scope: Phase 5: funds-only capacity and SELL-first model; this BUG does not claim full MiniQMT Phase0-7 completion.
expected: MiniQMT strategy count is governed only by capital capacity and trading rules. For over-capacity rebalance, SELL orders that pass can_sell are submitted first; BUY orders are cash-fit, scaled, skipped with SKIPPED_INSUFFICIENT_CAPITAL/PARTIAL_CAPITAL_ALLOCATED/MIN_LOT_NOT_REACHED, or residual WAITING_FOR_SELL_PROCEEDS without fake success. Unfilled/partial/rejected SELL must not release proceeds prematurely.
